commenti.body:
My thoughts:

I love a lot of the films in the top 100 but also note some key exclusions.  
  
I feel like animation and documentaries are especially underrepresented in this list and that it underrates some key films and filmmakers. IE, Steven Spielberg, Walt Disney, Abbas Kiarostami, Joel & Ethan Coen, Preston Sturges, Marcel Carné together have a single film in the top 250.  
  
No Fantasia or Bambi.  
  
Jean Renoir, unless I'm mistaken, has a single film in the top 400. John Huston doesn't appear until #362. Peter Weir does not make the top 600. Neither Carlos Saura nor Claude Chabrol appear at all. Neither do Elaine May, Jafar Panahi or Juzo Itami.

None of the key concert movies like *The Last Waltz*, *Woodstock*, *Monterey Pop* or *Stop Making Sense* make the list. No documentaries at all, as far as I can tell.

But of course there are a lot of absolutely essential films on this list, and many that I'm lucky to see as high as they are (*Barry Lyndon*, *Lawrence of Arabia*, *Vertigo*, *The Rules of the Game*,)

What are your thoughts?
